summary_1line: After Damayanti chooses Nala, the enraged spirit Kali vows revenge, later entering Nala through a small lapse and plotting his ruin via a rigged dice game.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kali, dark and furious, confronts the departing gods on the road and swears vengeance because Damayanti chose the mortal king Nala.
An unseen dark spirit slips into Nala's body as he performs twilight prayers after neglecting to wash his feet by the water.
Dwapara transforms into the chief die while Pushkara approaches King Nala inviting him to a fateful game of dice.
